Name: HxW Tilesheets
Author: HimeTarts
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/OwUV43F.png[/img]

A resource for modders providing fun, furniture tilesheets for their use in custom maps. ﻿[/center]
Included up to 2.0.0 release:
[list]
[*][b]Outdoor [/b]set (greenhouse + outdoor sets) (seasonal)
[*][b]Fountains[/b] set (romantic fountains + fairy fountains) (seasonal)
[*][b]Romantic[/b] set (romantic furniture + buildings)
[*][b]Fairy Garden[/b] set (non-seasonal)
[*][b]Fairy Garden Indoors[/b] (non-seasonal)
[*][b]Bathroom [/b]set (non-seasonal)
[*][b]Farmer's Market [/b](Vanilla produce set + Wildflour produce set + butcher set + fishery set)
[*][b]Bakery Sets [/b](Farmer's market + Bakery  + Boutique Bakery)
[*][b]Decorative Plants[/b]
[*][b]Plant Lovers[/b]
[*][b]Kitchen Lovers[/b]
[*][b]Winery Furniture[/b]
[*][b]Forest Cafe[/b]
[*][b]Outdoor Flowers (seasonal)[/b]
[*][b]Florist Furniture[/b]
[*][b]New Trees[/b]
[/list]
How to use:

[b]For players: [/b]Install as you would any other mod if listed as a dependency. Nothing more!

[b]For modders: [/b]You can add the tilesheets in this mod like you would add any custom tilesheet to your map, they're already loaded into the game. Only set this mod as a dependency for yours. [b]Please make sure to delete the png before publishing.[/b] Do not release your mod with the tilesheets included within, as that is asset redistribution. 
 
[b]On editing assets: [/b]You may edit assets in these tilesheets like changing colors of elements or including them into art assets directly [b]so long as this mod is listed as a dependency.[/b] Ideally, please make sure the majority use is assets as they are and not edited assets.

[b]On recolor compatibility: [/b]We're providing vanilla versions and muted versions that should be compatible with recolors such as Daisyniko's or VPR. But if you wish to recolor these tilesheets to be compatible with specific recolors, feel free to provide us with the assets, and we'll be glad to add them to the main mod. 

Tilesheets coming in the next releases:

[list]
[*]Full bakery/cafe set. (In production, halfway done)
[*]The rest of the farmer's market sets: Bakery, cheesery, winery. (In production, early stage)
[*]Boutique / Fashion Store furniture. (Finished, coming soon)
[/list]
Credits:
Skellady who wrote the bulk of the mod's code because I was terrified. 
Wildflour who did all the toned down recolor compatibility because her color use is stunning.
And me who did all the sprite art for the mod!
